logo.description: A 3D geometric 'H' icon made of two interlocking arrows — a blue arrow pointing upward-right representing growth and efficiency, and a red arrow/chevron below representing action and reliability. Below the icon: 'HNeef' in dark grey serif text, 'Efficiency Services' in red, and 'Streamline Your Success' as an italic blue script tagline. Designed on a dark charcoal background.
